messages:
sandy: Packaging lead here — prepping airgap transport-bridge artifact for customer cutover tomorrow 07:00 UTC. Need post-install smoke checks + KMS signer handshake confirmation. Planning to pin on-prem images to sha256, want canary to 2 customers first.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Release window reserved 07:00-07:30 UTC. Canary group enabled. Sequential rollout policy: group A -> group B -> global. Notifying on-call.

mira: ACK. I can run the postinstall smoke script and validate node partitioning. Where are the exact checks documented?

sandy: docs in repo under ops/airgap/transport-bridge/README.md. Quick snippet to run preflight:
```
./postinstall-smoke.sh --target /mnt/airgap --verify-checksums
```
Checks: service start, KMS handshake, manifest signature verify, disk mount sanity.

jamal: KMS handshake flow tested in staging yesterday, policy TTL is 24h. If handshake fails during canary we should rotate the ephemeral signer key and retry once, otherwise rollback.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Metric alert template created: airgap.transport_bridge.postinstall.failure -> page on >=2 hosts in 15m. Also Slack alarm to #eng-oncall.

alex: For rollback criteria: if canary failure rate > 5% OR manifest signature mismatch -> immediate rollback to manifest pinned v1.14.1. I'll prep the rollback playbook and the pinned manifests.

sandy: Confirmed. Also we need release-notes snippet and the exact SHA pins in the delivery email to customers.

mira: I'll run checksum preflight at 02:00 UTC and paste the output here once done.

package-bot: package-bot: Signed manifest uploaded to s3://redwood-airgap/releases/2026-03-21/manifest-v1.14.2.signed. Cosign signature attached.

jamal: Quick verification command for cosign I used in staging:
```
cosign verify-blob --signature manifest-v1.14.2.sig manifest-v1.14.2
```
Verified successfully.

sandy: Draft release notes:
- transport-bridge: KMS handshake hardening and retry logic
- postinstall smoke checks added for on-prem installers
- images pinned to immutable SHAs for reproducible installs
Please review, @mira @jamal.

mira: LGTM, will post preflight logs in this thread at ~03:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started 07:00 UTC -> will post status every 2 minutes to thread. Good luck :rocket:

sandy: Canary update 07:12 UTC — first two customers passed postinstall checks, KMS handshake OK, no service restarts observed. Promoting to full rollout now.

alex: Noted. Rolling back playbook stands by in case the global fail conditions trigger.

sandy: Closing: promotion complete, packaging and transport bridge delivered. Will open a short postmortem if any late regressions appear. :thumbsup:
